component.name: QtAdb Reforged
component.summary: Graphical front-end for adb (Android Debug Bridge)
adb（Android 调试桥）的图形前端

description.p: QtAdb Reforged is the continuation of QtAdb by the same author: a Qt 6 desktop tool that bundles its own adb lookup and turns common adb operations into a GUI — device information, package management, permission listing, activation helpers, key emulation and more.
This release is a code rebuild (91 rounds of AI-assisted refactoring) rather than a feature release: the aim was robustness, maintainability, extensibility and readability.
First packaged Linux build: self-contained Qt 6 bundle plus the official Linux adb.
